spans.s: (I)--An अवतार् of Hari as son of अकूती and रुची: begot on दक्षिणा, gods called Suyamas. भा.

(II)--a king of उशीनरस्, fell in battle. His relations and queens bemoaned his loss bitterly beating their breasts. At this Yama appeared before them in the form of a child and demonstrated the instability of life, comparable only to a dream. Even ages of mourning will not help the dead man to come back. Saying this he disappeared. This impressed them so much that they retired to forest after performing funeral obsequies. भा.
(IV)--a son of अक्षर and father of उशनस्. Br. III. ७०. २३.
--sons of सुयज्ञ, an अवतार् of Hari. भा.
--a son of अशोकवर्धन, and father of Sangata (दशरथ-वि। प्।). भा.
(I)--a queen of दिवोदास who prayed at Nikumbha's temple for a son but did not get: so her husband got it destroyed. Br. III. ६७. ४७-9; वा. ९२. ४४. ५१.
(III)--a daughter of Gandharvas; husband Pracetas; sons यक्षस् and four daughters all Apsaras. वा. ६९. १०. ११, and १३.
